segments.an5.229:1.3: Asuci, duggandho, sabhīru, sappaṭibhayo, mittadubbhī – ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā kaṇhasappe.
segments.an5.229:2.1: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcime ādīnavā mātugāme.
segments.an5.229:2.3: Asuci, duggandho, sabhīru, sappaṭibhayo, mittadubbhī – ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā mātugāme”ti.

lines: Sappaṭibhayoti taṃ nissāya bhayaṃ uppajjati, tasmā sappaṭibhayo.
